abstract: In a meeting of the IEEE-ASSP Technical Committee in Speech Processing at the United Engineering Center in New York City, USA on 6 June 1979, Dr. B. Beek, Dr. N.R. Dixon, Dr. R.A. Houde, Dr. T.B. Hartin, Dr. L.R. Rabiner and Dr. A.E. Rosenberg, members attending, decided that effective immediately after ICASSP-80, the committee will be constituted of twelve members, including a Chairperson. These twelve members will be representative of universities and research institutes, industrial research and de1elopment organizations, speech processing equipment advanced technology and manufacturing firms, and governmental agencies. Additional committee rules are noted.

abstract: Nominations are solicited from members of the ASSP Society for the 1979 awards to be presented at the 1980 ICASSP in Denver, Colorado. The awards and their associated criteria follow. ASSP Society Award: To honor a person who has made outstanding technical contributions in a field within the scope of the Society and who has provided outstanding leadership in that field. Technical Achievement Award: To honor a person who, over a period of yeqrs, has made outstanding technical contributions within the scope of the Society as documented by publications or patents. Senior Award: To honor a person who is an author of a paper (published in the year ending June 1979) of exceptional technical scope, and appearing in the Society's TRANSACTIONS, irrespective of the author's age. ASSP Paper Award: To honor a person who is the author of an especially meritorious paper (ptwlished in the year ending June 1979) dealing with a subject related to the Society's technical scope appearing in the Society's TRANSACTIONS; and who upon data of submission of the paper shall be less than 30 years of age. Meritorious Service Award: To honor a person on the basis of significant contributions to the Society's efforts.
